limitations: Reset request is statically traced; physical reset success and boot-ROM path were not executed or observed.
Completed normal app startup zeroes the covered RAM. Later initialization and restored persistent records are distinct. No nonvolatile erase claim.
RF-only reconnect may use branches without normal startup. Deferred task consumers and actual reset selection remain open.
No exhaustive all-encoding, alias or indirect-writer analysis. DV209 0xe976 operands remain excluded.
Same-sequence duplicate suppression is a single last-byte comparison. No session epoch, all-history exactly-once or stale-Finish execution guarantee.
Search failures on unsupported REP/table boundaries excluded from bounded clean run; known NOT p-code error explicitly superseded by independent official witness.
No new storage ACK requirement, writable backend, blind Start/Exit/Finish replay or hardware command supplied.
